name: Data Lake Analytics
description: Agent wired to the Athena-for-Spark PySpark submit/poll/results tools (issue #501) plus the S3 filesystem tools (issue #240) — runs ad-hoc PySpark queries against the data lake and renders plot/artifact output in chat.
